name: rad-plugin-converter
description: Audit and convert Claude Code, Codex, legacy, and mixed plugin packages to Agent Plugins 1.0.0.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and convert plugin packages to Agent Plugins 1.0.0.
interface.longDescription: RAD Plugin Converter audits Claude Code, Codex, legacy, and mixed plugin packages. It creates a portable Agent Plugins manifest while retaining documented client compatibility files. It can also check and safely repair Agent Skills metadata.
